head: Google homepage redesign: Gemini sidebar with your chats on desktop
dek: The Google Search homepage on computers is getting Gemini shortcuts under the search bar for making images, analysing files and brainstorming, in place of the Google Search button. A new sidebar lists your Gemini chats and tasks with a New chat button.
details: Google's Robby Stein said the redesign is rolling out worldwide; 9to5Google confirmed it on 19 November but didn't see it on its own devices yet. The report covers the desktop page only and doesn't mention a way to switch it off.
where: google.com on computers, rolling out worldwide from 19 November
means: If your Google page suddenly looks different, this is why: the Gemini sidebar and shortcuts are part of Google's new layout, and the search bar is still there.
todo: Nothing to do. The sources don't mention a setting to bring back the old page.
